tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Base surface: chat canvas and app ground. Darkest tonal step in dark themes.

tokens.name: bg-panel
tokens.usage: Chrome surface: sidebar, header below 769px, tab strip on phones, terminal-adjacent panels.

tokens.name: bg-elevated
tokens.usage: Tonal lift on bg-panel: selection, chips, segmented tracks, the user's chat bubble.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and aria-selected fill for rows, menu items and controls.

tokens.name: bg-input
tokens.usage: Field and composer input fill.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline (1px) on shell, fields, controls; the dashed edge of unknown/empty states.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Stronger edge for hover/focus separation, kbd bottom edge, meter tracks.

tokens.name: bubble-border
tokens.usage: Edge of the user's chat bubble: transparent where bg-elevated alone parts it from bg (dark amber, report, charcoal), {border} where the two sit close (every light theme, Catppuccin Mocha).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, bg-panel, bg-elevated and bg-hover.

tokens.name: text-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, field labels, hints, uppercase micro headings. On bg, bg-panel, bg-elevated.

tokens.name: text-strong
tokens.usage: Titles, strong in chat prose, the open tab and selected names.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE chrome colour (amber): selection rail, focus ring, links, chosen lens glyph, terminal cursor. In light it is the darker, text-safe ochre. Never an agent state.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Accent wash behind selected/informational marks.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The user's own action: Send, primary buttons. Fill carrying primary-text.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Soft primary wash (pressed or pending primary states).

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: Agent state READY / idle; also the unknown state (with a dashed edge). Always paired with the written label.

tokens.name: status-working
tokens.usage: Agent state RUN (working), with a breathing dot; PC connecting/reconnecting pulse.

tokens.name: status-blocked
tokens.usage: Agent state INPUT (blocked, needs you); errors, danger items, meters past 80%.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: Agent state DONE; PC connected dot.

tokens.name: status-working-tint
tokens.usage: Badge/row fill behind status-working text.

tokens.name: status-blocked-tint
tokens.usage: Badge/row fill behind status-blocked text.

tokens.name: status-done-tint
tokens.usage: Badge/row fill behind status-done text.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of danger buttons, the offline pill and inline failures.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Text on danger-tint fills.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals, the palette and the mobile drawer.

tokens.name: portal-glow
tokens.usage: The radial glow at the top of every portal page (1200×600 at 50% −200px, fading to transparent at 60%).

tokens.name: portal-bg-elev
tokens.usage: Portal cards and panels (.card, section.panel, .stat). Text: portal-text, portal-text-muted (6.3:1).

tokens.usage: Portal inputs, target rows, code chips, the brand dot; secondary button hover. portal-text-muted reads 5.5:1 here.

tokens.usage: Portal hairlines on cards, inputs, tables and secondary buttons (decorative: 1.3:1 on portal-bg-elev).

tokens.name: portal-text-muted
tokens.usage: Portal labels, meta lines, uppercase h2s, table heads; on portal-bg-elev (6.3:1) and portal-bg-elev-2 (5.5:1).

tokens.name: portal-accent
tokens.usage: Data Agile green: primary buttons, links, the admin badge, the AGILE half of the wordmark. 8.9:1 on portal-bg-elev. Never put white text on it (1.8:1 — the help page tabs and step numbers do; use portal-accent-ink).

tokens.name: portal-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: portal-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text on portal-accent fills (9.1:1).

tokens.name: portal-ok
tokens.usage: Healthy machine badge text ("online").

tokens.name: portal-danger
tokens.usage: Danger buttons, offline badges; 5.1:1 on portal-bg-elev.

tokens.name: portal-danger-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of error alerts and danger button hover.

tokens.name: portal-danger-edge
tokens.usage: Border of danger buttons and offline badges (error alert: 0.35).

tokens.name: portal-error-text
tokens.usage: Error alert text on portal-danger-tint.

tokens.name: portal-success-text
tokens.usage: Success alert text; the help page mock's "ok" marks. Its fill is rgba(63, 185, 80, 0.12), edge 0.35–0.4.

tokens.name: portal-warn
tokens.usage: Warning accents (help page approval mock); 6.4:1 on portal-bg-elev.

tokens.name: portal-focus
tokens.usage: Input focus halo (3px). A blue left from an earlier palette: it does not match the green accent — keep or replace deliberately.

tokens.name: portal-scrim
tokens.usage: Help page tour overlay (with a 4px backdrop blur); the image lightbox uses 0.92.
